rules.name: Fixed admission period for F, J and I visa holders (end of 'duration of status')
rules.changes: Would have capped international students', exchange visitors' and foreign journalists' stays at fixed terms, generally up to four years, instead of open-ended 'duration of status'. A court has now struck it down.
rules.affects: International students, postdocs and researchers (including many from India), foreign journalists, and US universities.

rules.name: Bill on special protection of certain gas consumers in 2027 (gas price freeze)
rules.changes: Caps the gas price at 197.29 zł/MWh net (the 2026 level) for all of 2027 for protected customers. Sellers are compensated from a fund financed by a 10% levy on large gas importers' net revenues. URE-approved tariffs are kept for protected customers until end-2030.
rules.affects: Households, housing cooperatives, schools, hospitals, care homes, churches and shelters that use gas, and gas importers such as Orlen.

deepDive.title: Inflation, budgets and AI money: the economy this Tuesday
deepDive.body:
**The oil shock still drives India.** Wholesale inflation hit 12.29% in October, the highest in the current series, almost entirely because fuel and power jumped about 33%. With retail inflation above the RBI's 6% ceiling, economists expect a rate rise on 4 December ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/amp/economy/news/wpi-inflation-rises-to-12-29-in-october-as-fuel-power-prices-surge-126111600916_1.html)).

**Poland is moving the other way.** Core inflation fell to 2.9% and headline CPI to 3.5%, supporting further rate cuts. The government is due today to adopt a 2027 gas price freeze worth about 6.2bn zł, paid for by a levy on big importers rather than the budget.

**Kraków's budget tests Gibała's austerity claims.** Krakowski Raport argues that higher PIT forecasts, not the 300m zł of announced savings, explain most of the smaller 2027 deficit ([Krakowski Raport](https://krakowskiraport.pl/artykul/3100-krakow-zaciska-pasa-wydatki-w-budzecie-na-2027-rok-rosna-o-412-mln-zl)).

**US markets wait on AI**: Nvidia reports tonight and Anthropic lists on Thursday, with a December Fed hike still possible.

**Trade: no new tariffs.** Trump calls his Asia trip mostly about economics. India brings a $51.6bn ASEAN deficit to Manila, and the India–US deal now targets March 2027 ([Outlook India](https://www.outlookindia.com/international/narendra-modi-manila-asean-summit-india-trade-deficit-aitiga-exports-imports)).

readInFull.title: Kraków zaciska pasa? Wydatki w budżecie na 2027 rok rosną o 412 mln zł
readInFull.why: Checks the city's 300m zł savings claim against the budget documents. It finds that higher tax forecasts, not cuts, do most of the work, and it lists the culture and sport cuts the city's announcement left out.
